name: Raphael
description: One of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints; sent to heal Tobit's blindness and to loose Sara from Asmodeus the evil spirit; accompanied Tobias to Media disguised as a kinsman, naming himself Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and claiming kinship with Tobit's brethren, a cover identity he revealed to be false only on departing (12:15)

points: The prayers of them both were heard, and Raphael was sent to heal Tobit's eyes and to give Sarah to Tobias, because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
